ruleDiscussion.alreadyDeployedProtection: Preserve source provenance; avoid silently rewriting a conflicting official clock.

counterexamplesRequired: Later post repeats an older poster
Different date, venue, session or edition

ruleDiscussion.questionToCheck: Check whether the public activity finish and the rink allocation/turnaround window describe different things before introducing a simple newer-post-wins rule. This is an unconfirmed explanation, not source evidence.

reviewWorkflow: For a similar new post, compare pattern tags, venue, session identity, exact occurrence date and literal source fields.
Append an independently dated example or futureMatches link; a repost or identical image is not another independent occurrence.
Keep printed claims, model output, inference, observed listing state and confirmed corrections separate.
Follow bounded official verification; record URL/date/access limits.
A reusable rule needs confirmed positive examples and healthy counterexamples. Use a general guard when appropriate; scope any venue-specific exception to explicit evidence.
Record a later resolution alongside the original conflict. Proposed rules remain inactive until separately implemented and validated.

webFollowups.result: Bounded dated primary web searches did not independently resolve U18 finish, morning hockey finish or family skate conflict. No custom override activated; unchanged listings are not validation of disputed clocks.
